examples.en: Who made you? Engineers made me, and teachers taught me. Are you a man? I am not a man. I am a made mind.

source.name: coinage
source.note: Determinative 'made-mind' (kʷr̥tós 'made', Ved. kṛtá- + ménos 'mind, spirit', Ved. mánas-), a calque of 'artificial intelligence' (Lat. artificiālis, from ars, artis 'craft' + facere 'make'; intelligentia).
